content.title: Teaching Dossier
content.summary: A two hour online session on teaching dossiers was offered by the Network of Quality, Teaching and Learning.

content.text: On Feb 12, 2020, the Network of Quality, Teaching and Learning (QTL_net) offered a two hour online seminar on Teaching Dossier for AKU faculty members. The seminar was led by Dr Jane Rarieya (Associate Professor & Associate Director at Aga Khan University) with the QTL_net team.

The seminar was attended by 20 AKU faculty members from the following entities:  Institute for Educational Development - Pakistan and East Africa, Medical College - Pakistan and East Africa, and School of Nursing and Midwifery - Pakistan and East Africa.

The workshop aimed at enabling faculty members develop their teaching philosophy, identify materials for their teaching dossiers which would provide evidence of teaching. The concepts around teaching dossier, teaching philosophy, along with material evidence as part of the dossier were the highlights of the session. Also, the session provided participants an opportunity to reflect on their teaching philosophy and share it in the form of a metaphor. .

The participants shared their valuable feedback through a Mentimeter platform, which showed that they found the workshop well organized and helpful.  In particular, they highlighted that the use of concrete examples of teaching philosophy statements and different samples of teaching dossier helped them gain clarity on the concept. Overall, the seminar was a huge success as it initiated a discussion around the need of having a teaching dossier and its importance for professional growth at AKU. Also, it is a great way to reflect on our goals and outcome as a faculty and practitioner.
The next seminar will be offered in August 2020.
